_about: The Notes clipboard regression bank (see ui-audit/lib/pasteBank.mjs). `outlines` = the clipboard-lists fixtures and the outline each must become (moved here from verify-notes-list-paste.mjs's WANT table — that harness keeps its own copy); `entries` = the cases added with the bank; the clipboard-tables fixtures take their expectation from that directory's manifest.json. A fixture committed to any of the three directories without an entry fails test/notesPasteBank.test.js.

spike-bgcolor-attr.about: Spike loss 1 — a fill written as the legacy bgcolor attribute. DECIDED BEHAVIOUR (notesTableFill.js / notesPasteModes.js): a plain paste imports NO foreign cell shading; 'Values and Source Formatting' (E) applies it. So the default paste is judged no-fill and the option is judged to bring the bgcolor fills in.

spike-font-color.about: Spike loss 2 — <font color> / <font face> (the HTML 3.2 spelling Office still emits) lost the colour and the typeface.

expect.plainText: Red words and blue Arial words and plain.

spike-excel-nbsp-cell.about: Spike loss 3a — Excel's   cell (and its truly empty ) arrived as a cell holding a space; an empty cell must be EMPTY.

spike-word-o-p-cell.about:
Spike loss 3b — Word's

 

cell arrived as a space, and Word's trailing spacer paragraph must not become content.

spike-word-bullets.about: Spike loss 4 — Word bullets (mso-list, Symbol glyph) arrived as '·' paragraphs; a bulleted list and a numbered list in one clipboard must become two real lists with a paragraph between.

excel-mixed-cells.about: An Excel range with a merged header, a filled cell, an empty cell, a bold cell and a red-text cell — formats written as CLASSES in the head <style>, which is how Excel really writes a whole-cell format. Default paste: marks arrive, shading does not (decided); 'Values and Source Formatting' brings the shading.

browser-block-styles.about:
NEW-2 (2026-11-10): THE REAL CLIPBOARD of Chromium 1254 after Ctrl+C on a styled page (captured by selecting two paragraphs whose red serif font comes from a stylesheet class; ui-audit/capture-chrome-copy.mjs). Chrome writes the computed colour / font-family / font-size on each

itself — never on a span — and the parser only reads a font, size or colour off a span, so Keep Source Formatting took the font, size and colour away. Every run must keep all three, plus bold / italic / underline / strike / highlight / link.

expect.plainText: Red serif paragraph copied from a chat answer in a browser.Then bold words, italic words, underlined words, struck words, highlighted words and a link.

word-class-font.about: NEW-2 (2026-11-10): Word desktop. The document font is NOT on the run — it comes from `p.MsoNormal { font-family: Calibri; font-size: 11pt }` in the clipboard's <style>, so a run with only a colour lost its font; a highlighter is `background:yellow;mso-highlight:yellow` on a span. Every run keeps the font and size the page showed; the explicit Cambria 14pt red run keeps its own.

runs.text: Red words in the document font
